title: AI Analog Circuit Design Agents : On Knowledge Extraction and Transfer with Knowledge Graphs
problem: Automating analog circuit design lacks generalizability—insights from optimizing one circuit topology often cannot be applied to different topologies, requiring repeated design effort.
motivation: Enabling topology-agnostic knowledge transfer allows reuse of design insights across different circuit types, mirroring human designer expertise.
method: ADO-KT uses LLMs for three integrated steps: (1) LLM-enabled knowledge graph generation from prior designs, (2) knowledge graph refinement for quality assurance, (3) topology-agnostic knowledge transfer for new circuit optimization. This enables seamless knowledge reuse between circuits of varying types.
key_novelty: LLM-based knowledge graphs for extracting and transferring topology-agnostic analog design knowledge.
contributions: LLM-enabled knowledge graph generation for analog design knowledge extraction
Quality refinement process for knowledge graph optimization
Topology-agnostic knowledge transfer enabling design reuse across circuit types
Significant improvements in design quality and data efficiency
limitations: Abstract lacks quantitative performance metrics; transferability claims not numerically validated.
primary_theme: LLM-based knowledge transfer for analog circuit design
